name: Community invite
description: Recruits people into a community, newsletter, or working group. Sells membership by naming who is already inside and what happens there, never by describing the community as "a place to connect".
audience: Practitioners who would make the community better by being in it — not a broad list. Quality of the room is the product.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — I run a small group of {{title|people doing what you do}} and it would be better with you in it. Connecting to explain properly.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — putting together a group of practitioners in your field and your name came up twice. Happy to connect and tell you what it actually is.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. What it is: about eighty practitioners, one thread a week where somebody posts a real problem, and a call once a month. No vendors, no recruiters. Want an invite?
The honest description, {{firstName|there}}: eighty people, one genuinely hard question a week, monthly call, nobody selling anything. Shall I send you in?
{{firstName|Hi}} — happy to send last month's thread so you can judge the standard before joining anything.
Want to lurk first, {{firstName|there}}? I'll forward the last two discussions and you can decide from there.
I'll leave the door open, {{firstName|there}} — no expiry on the invite. Come find me whenever.
Standing invitation, {{firstName|there}}. That's the last you'll hear from me about it.
